title: Moody's: major US life insurers like Athene held $85.2B in AI debt as of June 30, up 24% from December 31, and the figure could rise to $185B by the end of 2027 (New York Times)
summary: New York Times: Moody's: major US life insurers like Athene held $85.2B in AI debt as of June 30, up 24% from December 31, and the figure could rise to $185B by the end of 2027 — Insurance companies are investing billions of their customers' money into A.I. deals as analysts warn of mounting risks.
